19 days to apply Apply by: 16/12/2026 Start date: 01/09/2027

## What's Your Possible?

Take on a role where your analytical thinking, curiosity and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future.

As a Finance Graduate, you'll rotate across a broad range of finance activities, gaining valuable experience in accounting operations, financial reporting, governance, business analysis and finance transformation projects. You'll develop a strong understanding of how finance supports business performance while building practical experience in financial processes, controls, systems and stakeholder management.

This is an excellent opportunity for graduates who enjoy understanding business challenges, working with data and collaborating with others to support better commercial decision-making. You'll gain exposure to both operational and strategic finance activities while developing analytical, technical and project management skills within a leading European energy business.

## What Will You Do?

- Gain hands-on experience across Accounting Operations, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger and Master Data Management activities, helping to maintain accurate financial records and efficient financial processes.
- Contribute to month-end and year-end close activities, including journal preparation, balance sheet reconciliations and financial data reviews to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
- Analyse financial and operational data, preparing reports and management information that support business performance monitoring and decision-making.
- Assist with documenting business processes, gathering requirements and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, controls and ways of working.
- Contribute to Finance Systems and Transformation initiatives, supporting project activities, testing, training and change management programmes.
- Participate in finance projects and cross-functional initiatives, helping to coordinate activities, monitor progress and support successful delivery of project objectives.
- Assist with maintaining finance policies, procedures and internal controls, helping to strengthen governance, compliance and risk management frameworks.
- Support internal and external audit activities by preparing information, tracking actions and collaborating with stakeholders to address findings and recommendations.
- Work closely with colleagues across Finance, Treasury, Procurement, IT and Audit teams, building an understanding of how different business functions work together.
- Take ownership of your professional development, applying new knowledge and contributing fresh ideas to support continuous improvement across the Finance function.

## What Will You Bring?

We're looking for curious, commercially-aware graduates who are eager to build a career in finance within a dynamic international business. You'll enjoy analysing information, solving problems and using data to support decision-making, while bringing a proactive approach to learning and development.

You'll ideally have:

- A Bachelor's degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts), preferably in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Business, Data Analytics or another numerate discipline.
- A strong academic background and a genuine interest in finance, business performance and commercial operations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret information, identify issues and recommend effective solutions.
- Excellent organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, enabling effective collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across the business.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint, together with an interest in finance systems, process improvement and business transformation initiatives.
- Curiosity about emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence, and an interest in data analysis, modelling and tools such as Python to improve financial processes and business outcomes.
- Adaptability, resilience and a commitment to continuous learning. Experience gained through internships, placements, part-time work, university projects or extracurricular activities related to finance, business or project work would be advantageous but is not essential.

Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted.

SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany.

Securing energy – now and for the future.

# Graduate Finance Assistant

 Location: London

 Salary: 30000-35000

 Contract Type: Permanent / Full Time

Graduate Finance Assistant We are really excited to be partnering with a growing business based in Central London on the recruitment of an entry-level Graduate Finance Assistant! You will get stuck into both accounts payable and accounts receivable, which makes this a brilliant chance to get your foot in the door of finance. The manager is genuinely supportive when it comes to growth and development, so you will learn a huge amount and build your experience fast. If you have a degree or are studying towards AAT and want to turn that learning into your first finance role, then this could be the role for you. The business wants someone with real study behind them, plenty of curiosity and a willingness to learn the job from the ground up. You will see how a finance team really works, and be in the Central London office three days a week to learn from the people around you. What You Will Be Doing

- Getting stuck into accounts payable, matching supplier invoices to purchase orders and keeping everything accurate
- Learning how accounts receivable works, from raising sales invoices to posting cash receipts
- Answering supplier and colleague queries by phone and email, and learning when to escalate
- Helping to set up new suppliers and learning why checking bank details properly matters
- Checking staff expense claims and helping to process payments
- Reconciling supplier statements each week, so you really see how the ledgers fit together
- Sending monthly statements to customers and helping chase payments
- Supporting the weekly bank reconciliation and monthly reporting
- Sitting close to your manager, who will teach you the role properly
- Building the skills and confidence to take on more as you grow

 What We Need From You

- Study is a must: a finance or accounting related degree, or AAT studies currently under way
- This is an entry-level role, so a degree or AAT is the right level, rather than ACCA or CIMA
- Prior finance experience would be brilliant but is not essential
- A CV that shows you have gone the extra mile, whether that is internships, volunteering or anything else you have done to gain experience
- Any Excel knowledge, including a course through your studies, which is a real winner
- GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent) and a good eye for detail
- Someone who is happy to settle in and take time to learn, owns their mistakes and asks questions, because in a small team there is nowhere to hide
- Ready to be in the Central London office three days a week, and ideally available at short notice

 What’s in it for you

- A genuine first step into a finance career, with no need for years of experience
- Hands-on training from a manager who is really supportive of your growth and development
- Experience across both accounts payable and accounts receivable from the start
- A small, close team where you will be properly supported and learn faster
- Room to progress as your experience and confidence grow
- Three days in the Central London office, with two working from home

 If this sounds like the perfect place to start your finance career, we would love to hear from you.

No two projects are the same, giving you the opportunity to work with a wide range of organisations, industries and people.

From an early stage, you’ll build relationships with clients and work closely with experienced colleagues across MHA. You’ll ask questions, gather financial and commercial information, research businesses and markets, and contribute to reports and presentations for clients. - Attending client meetings and developing relationships; and
- Assisting with the efficient project management of transaction processes.
- Studying towards Professional Qualification (ACA Level 7)

For trainees, we ask for full office attendance during the first six months to ensure you receive the training, support and experience needed for a strong start, with greater flexibility available after that.

# Financial Accounting Manager

- Job Reference: 3090185363-2
- Date Posted: 26 November 2026
- Recruiter: Orka Financial
- Location: Staines, South East
- Salary: £75,000 to £80,000
- Sector: Accounting
- Job Type: Permanent

## Job Description

Orka Financial is recruiting a Financial Accounting Manager for a permanent, full-time position based in Staines. The role offers £75,000-£80,000 per annum, a 10% bonus and benefits.

The opportunity

This is a senior technical-accounting role within a complex international finance function. Acting as deputy to the Accounting Director, you will help protect the quality of financial reporting and controls across several legal entities while leading improvements to systems, processes and governance.

Key responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership across statutory accounting, group reporting and complex accounting matters.

• Support reporting under UK GAAP, FRS 102, IFRS and US GAAP requirements.

• Strengthen the SOX control environment and improve the day-to-day effectiveness of key controls.

• Lead the preparation of trial balances, financial statements, technical papers and audit information.

• Coordinate with external auditors, tax specialists and senior stakeholders across finance and the wider business.

• Oversee group submissions, corporation tax reporting, balance-sheet reviews and selected regulatory returns.

• Lead accounting projects, systems upgrades and practical process-improvement work.

• Coach junior colleagues and supervise a finance intern on a rotational basis.

What you will bring

• ACA or ACCA qualification.

• Strong audit and technical-accounting experience under UK GAAP and IFRS.

• Sound knowledge of statutory reporting, controls and complex balance-sheet matters.

• Confidence operating in a large, matrixed organisation and advising senior stakeholders.

• Advanced Excel skills and the ability to work comfortably with significant volumes of data.

• A clear, practical communication style and strong attention to detail.

Experience in an international corporate environment and familiarity with Oracle or Hyperion would be useful. This opportunity suits a technically strong accountant who wants broad ownership, senior exposure and the scope to improve how a finance function operates.

Please apply online for consideration.

## Job description

About the role

Location: Bexhill or London

Welcome to Hastings Direct. We're a digital insurance provider with 5 million customers and ambitious plans to become the best and biggest in the UK. Our continued success depends on talented colleagues who are curious, commercially minded and motivated to improve outcomes for our customers. By joining Hastings Direct, you could play a part in the next chapter of our growth and innovation.

Programme overview

Finance is changing, and we want graduates who are ready to help shape what comes next. Over three years, you’ll build a broad understanding of Finance, our business and what drives our performance. Through varied rotations, you’ll gain experience in and learn the fundamentals of different areas of Finance, while working on real business challenges and developing the skills and confidence to contribute from the start. We’ll expect you to be curious, get involved and take ownership. That means delivering the essentials well, but also asking better questions, solving problems, utilising AI and challenging how things are done and looking for opportunities to make a difference. You’ll have the opportunity to explore different areas of Finance and discover where your strengths and ambitions could take you. Perform well and develop at pace, and we’ll look to match you with a permanent role at the end of the programme, based on your interests and the needs of the business.

Pathways

We offer two pathways, with rotations across different areas of Finance designed around your development, interests and experience, alongside the evolving needs of the business.

Finance Forward pathway – Develop into a commercially focused finance professional who helps drive business performance. You’ll use financial and business data to uncover opportunities; challenge thinking and turn insight into action. Along the way, you’ll build data and technology skills, as well as the commercial judgement and influencing skills to make an impact across the business. You’ll also have the option to work towards ACCA, with study support.

Financial Tech pathway – Develop the technology and data skills that will help shape the future of Finance. You’ll use data, automation and emerging technologies to improve how Finance works and drive commercial outcomes, with platforms such as Workday, SQL and Snowflake. You’ll also build a strong understanding of finance and accountancy fundamentals. Your development and qualifications will be tailored to your interests, experience and business needs, helping you build a career at the intersection of finance and technology. Our pathways provide direction, not boundaries. You’ll have the flexibility to gain experience across both and explore opportunities as your interests, skills and ambitions develop.

What you will develop

The programme is intended to build a strong foundation in the fundamentals of Finance, giving you practical experience of the core activities that keep the business running and an understanding of why they matter. Alongside this, you’ll build the capability to solve ambiguous problems with limited guidance, challenge constructively, identify opportunities and risks, and create measurable value through Finance, data, technology and AI. You'll develop the technical, commercial and relationship skills needed to progress towards senior Finance roles. Technology and ways of working in Finance are changing quickly, so continuous learning will be a core part of your career here. You'll be supported to build professional knowledge and if you undertake accounting or technology qualifications, you will be expected to pass relevant examinations in line with company policy.

What we are looking for

- Critical thinking and problem‑solving: You can structure unfamiliar or ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, evaluate alternatives and reach practical conclusions.
- Clear communication and influence: You can explain complex information clearly, adapt your message for different audiences and contribute constructively to decisions.
- Relationship building, collaboration and emotional intelligence: You work effectively with others, build trust, manage different perspectives and help groups align around a shared objective.
- Curiosity and learning agility: You learn quickly, seek knowledge beyond what is required and apply new skills to real problems. This is particularly important as Finance, data and AI continue to evolve.
- Ownership and initiative: You deliver reliably, take responsibility, look for improvements and act on opportunities rather than waiting to be directed.
- Analytical ability and data literacy: You are confident working with numerical and operational information, identifying root causes, testing assumptions and using evidence to support recommendations.
- Technology and AI aptitude: You are comfortable using digital tools and interested in how automation, data analytics and AI can improve productivity, control and insight.
- Resilience and adaptability: You respond constructively to setbacks, feedback and changing priorities, adapting your approach while maintaining quality and pace.
- Commercial awareness: You are interested in how organisations make money and can connect financial, economic or industry developments to business risks, opportunities and decisions.
- Attention to detail: You follow processes accurately and build in your own checks and controls to maintain high standards.
- Ethical judgement and integrity: You act responsibly, follow appropriate policies and controls, and raise concerns when something does not look right.

No specific degree discipline is required. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds who can demonstrate strong potential, curiosity and an interest in finance, commercial thinking, data and technology.

Timeline

- 23 November 2026 - Applications go live.
- 14 January 2027 11:00 PM - Applications will close.
- 19 January 2027 - Psychometric assessments must be completed by 11:00 PM.
- 25 January 2027 - If successful, you’ll then need to complete a role suitability practical assessment and/or video interview. You’ll receive a new web link for this.
- 8 February 2027 - Deadline for the practical assessment stage.
- 15-19 February 2027 - Successful candidates are contacted and invited to an onsite Assessment Centre.
- 16 & 17 March 2027 - In-person Assessment Centres in Bexhill.

Reward

- Competitive Starting Salary
- Competitive bonus scheme, subject to company and personal performance
- Pension contributions matched up to 10%
- 25 days annual leave
- Access to online learning platforms
- Healthcare cash plan and private medical insurance
- Life cover at 4 x Salary
- Year-round social events, free mortgage advice and more

Right to work and use of AI

Unfortunately, we cannot offer visa sponsorship for our graduate programmes. You must be able to demonstrate your right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme. We embrace AI as a tool to support our data-driven ambitions and improve how we work. You may use AI tools to help prepare your CV and cover letter. During the assessment process, however, all work must be completed independently and in line with the instructions provided so that we can fairly assess your own knowledge, skills and abilities.

Our 4Cs

Our 4Cs principles are simple. By creating the right culture for our colleagues and giving them the right tools to do their jobs, we deliver good outcomes for every customer, grow the company profitably and sustainably, and invest in the communities we serve. We deliver good outcomes for customers by providing great products at the right price, with a simple and straightforward service. We treat customers as we would want to be treated: fairly, respectfully and with their best interests at heart.

Hastings Group is an equal opportunities employer which means we treat people fairly. We welcome applications from all suitably skilled persons regardless of their gender, age, race, disability, ethnic background, religion/belief, sexual orientation, gender reassignment or marital/family status. Please also note that we have a thorough referencing process, which includes credit and criminal record checks. At Hastings Direct, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, we encourage you to be open with us. Our recruitment team is here to provide the support you need to ensure a fair and accessible experience for all.

Our vision – to be the best and biggest digital insurance provider in the market. It's our attitude and the way we run our business that makes us different. ## Job description

VFX Financial is one of the UK’s fastest-growing FinTechs, helping complex organisations move, manage, and protect money across borders. Built for specialist sectors, multi-jurisdiction structures, and high-compliance environments, we support businesses whose needs go beyond standard banking. We’re selective about who we work with because exceptional service requires focus and commitment.

With six international offices, six regulatory licences, and an 83% CAGR over the past three years, we’re scaling rapidly and earning industry recognition along the way — including the Financial Times FT1000: Europe’s Fastest Growing Companies 2026, CNBC UK’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, Wealth & Finance FinTech Awards 2026, and the Business Growth Award from Business Awards UK.

Behind it all is a team of ambitious VFXers united by collective ownership, a focus on growth, and a shared passion for solving complex problems.

About the Role

The Middle Office Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the integrity and efficiency of the FX post-trade process. This position is responsible for managing the full trade lifecycle, maintaining accurate reconciliations, and supporting margin and settlement activities. Acting as a key control point between Trading, Back Office, and Risk, the analyst monitors trading activity, resolves discrepancies, and escalates issues promptly to safeguard operational and financial risk. The role also contributes to process improvements and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

No prior work experience is necessary. This is a hands‑on role ideal for someone with a mathematics, finance, or other numerical‑related degree, strong analytical skills, and most importantly, a willingness to learn and develop.

Key Responsibilities

- Oversee the complete post-trade lifecycle of FX derivatives, from execution through to settlement, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
- Maintain robust trade capture, reconciliation, and control processes across multiple systems to safeguard data integrity.
- Monitor trading activity and operational flows, proactively identifying issues and escalating them to senior management when necessary.
- Collaborate effectively with Trading, Back Office, and Technology teams to resolve trade discrepancies and ensure seamless processing.
- Respond promptly to queries from Settlements and Payments teams, ensuring all transactions are reconciled daily and discrepancies are addressed without delay.
- Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of structured FX products, market risk, liquidity risk, and related operational considerations.
- Assist with process enhancements and automation initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
- Ensure comprehensive documentation and strict adherence to internal policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
- Manage trade reconciliation processes for both derivative and non‑derivative transactions, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
- Oversee margin call management for clients, including initial and variation margin, in line with contractual and regulatory obligations.
- Support the Financial Risk Manager in conducting credit facility reviews and monitoring counterparty exposures.

Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the Director of Trading, in line with the scope of the position, as reasonably required to support business and operational priorities.

Candidate Profile

Experience & Background

- Strong academic background in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another numerate discipline (or equivalent experience)
- Understanding of derivatives and financial risk concepts; FX derivatives exposure desirable.

Technical Skills

- Strong numeracy and analytical capability.
- Proficiency in Excel; exposure to VBA or automation tools beneficial.
- Familiarity with trade support or trade capture systems advantageous

Core Competencies

- Attention to Detail: Maintains high accuracy across repetitive and time-sensitive tasks.
- Problem‑Solving: Identifies discrepancies and works proactively to resolve issues.
- Collaboration: Works seamlessly with Trading, Back Office, Settlements, Payments, Technology, and Risk teams to ensure smooth operations.
- Ownership: Takes responsibility for assigned processes, controls, and timely completion of tasks.
- Adaptability: Responds effectively to fluctuating workloads, evolving system requirements, and market‑driven operational demands.
- Communication: Provides clear, concise, and timely updates to internal stakeholders; escalates issues appropriately.
- Risk Awareness: Monitors trading activity and operational flows, proactively escalating potential risks to senior management.
- Regulatory & Policy Compliance: Ensures adherence to internal policies, procedures, and relevant regulatory requirements in all activities.

Benefits at VFX

We offer more than just perks — we offer ownership.

Our benefits include:

- Generous Profit Share Plan (PSP)
- Potential equity opportunities via the Company Share Option Plan (CSOP)
- Hybrid working 3‑days per week at our Aldgate office
- Annual all-expenses paid company incentive trip abroad
- Flexible learning & development budget
- Weekly events like Supper Club, Thursday Happy Hour & regular socials
- Fresh fruit, breakfast staples & fully stocked drinks fridge in the office

At VFX, the biggest benefit is the opportunity to act like an owner. Through our Profit Share Scheme (PSP), every team member has a stake in the business by sharing in the profits.

To show you what that looks like, in 2025, PSP participants received over £1,000,000. Historically, VFX has also offered equity opportunities via Company Share Option Plan (CSOP), where more than 80% of eligible VFXers chose to become shareholders — a powerful reflection of the belief and commitment that drives VFX forward.

If you care about building something meaningful, take pride in your work, and are motivated by impact — you’ll thrive here.

Next Steps

This academy has been a great way for me to gain experience while studying towards a professional accounting qualification and continuing to develop personally.’ – Finance & Commercial Academy Student. What We’re Looking For We focus on potential, curiosity, and your drive to learn rather than a laundry list of past experience. 

- 5 GCSE’s at grade 4 or above including Mathematics and English Language.
- 3 A-levels (or BTEC/T-Level equivalent) at grade C or higher.

Purpose of job

This role is for a 12-month internship, working within the Impact & Partnerships Blended Finance team. The intern reports to the Associate Director and works closely alongside the Associate Manager, and the Analyst.

The role focuses on data analysis, management, and financial/econometric modelling of EBRD’s blended finance and overall donor funds portfolio (donor supported operations include both TA/TC projects and investment transactions). The resulting output and findings will support the production of reporting and knowledge products, inform donor funds/blended finance strategies policies, and presentations, and disseminate knowledge internally and externally to EBRD.

Accountabilities & responsibilities

- Support the preparation of analytical products, including the Donor Strategy, Annual Donor Report, Donor Funding Outlook, DFI Blended Concessional Finance Paper, and other internal/external products;
- Support the collection and reconciliation of raw data from both IT systems and teams, liaising with departments across the Bank for input as required;
- Support the continued maintenance and updating of internal databases and analytical tools (e.g. dashboards, financial models);
- Provide data analysis on blended finance and donor funds portfolio, for a wide range of internal and external stakeholders on an ad-hoc basis;
- Lead the development of financial models for donor funds and blended finance portfolio and transaction-level analysis;
- Support the production of communication products such as presentations, briefing notes, other donor visibility products;
- Support the production of research papers and knowledge products related to EBRD’s use of donor funds including blended finance, through econometric modelling, data analytics/visualisation and empirical analysis;
- Provide a range of administrative support tasks as required by the team.

Qualifications

- Graduate qualification (Masters) in Economics, Finance, Statistics, or other relevant degree.

Knowledge & expertise

- Experience in data analysis and management, with the ability to interpret technical/financial data into meaningful findings; these skills will be tested as part of the hiring process.
- Experience in cleaning of large datasets and data collection is required, knowledge in relational database management would be desirable.
- Proficiency in econometric modelling, computer programming (for data cleaning and management) and financial modelling (e.g. interpreting financial statements, running sensitivity/scenario analysis, cash flow modelling, etc.)
- Excellent knowledge in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required, experience in data analytics related software (e.g., Tableau, SQL, R, Stata) would be desirable.
- Knowledge of and interest in development finance and international relations.
- Ability to work effectively in teams across a multi-cultural environment.

- Ability to prioritise appropriately and work with varying levels of guidance; independent and self-driven, able to take initiative and adapt to new situations and tasks easily.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.

Job Description

We’re looking for an Senior Implementation Manager to join our Finance Product team in London.This role is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise’s mission by ensuring we build smart and scalable internal financial systems and empower millions more people with instant, borderless money.
Your Mission:
As a financial institution moving billions of GBP of customer money in more than 70 countries, Wise must have bulletproof financials.
As Wise expands globally, creating new products for our customers, and starting more lines of businesses, it introduces significant complexities to recording our financials. Some of these complexities are solved by creating new systems/tools or integrating with third party systems into our existing finance systems.
This role offers the unique opportunity which requires both technical and finance chops and will support Wise in being financially compliant while ensuring our bigger team can make timely, accurate and sustainable business decisions based on a global set of financials.
How you’ll contribute to our Mission:
• Our Finance Implementation team ensures that anything happening in Wise that has a financial impact is integrated into our financial systems and is properly recorded and controlled. This requires working closely with our finance, product and engineering teams on understanding how things work in Wise and how they translate into compliant financials.

• You’ll be responsible for understanding the whys and hows of the Wise and Finance integration and communicate across all finance stakeholders and financial concepts to engineers.

• You will figure out a plan and work with a team of implementation managers, engineers, analysts and operations specialists to ensure all.

• You will support the team with clear documentation including requirements, detailed project plans, resource allocation, testing, delivery etc.

• You will work with our internal finance teams, such as Accounting, Tax, Reporting and Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure clean, accurate and compliant financials in all our entities worldwide in a timely manner.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your path to impact – we believe people are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls.

• Get amazing exposure to the full breadth and depth of our internal product finance systems while working with a group of amazing and dedicated implementation managers, engineers, analysts, and operations.

• Work in a world-class international Finance Team, learn a lot about fintech and finance and drive financial sustainability of Wise, while also building a high-volume, real time financial implementation system.

• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal.

Qualifications

A bit about you:
• You’re hands on. You’d do everything needed to make the team and the product successful. You get it done.

• Experience with ERP systems as a must.

• Expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, especially in financial system integrations, and understand how to integrate it with internal and third-party systems for accurate financial data.

• Working with business process servicing (invoices, payments).

• System Integration: You’ve successfully scoped and integrated external systems with internal systems, ensuring smooth data flow and timely, accurate financial reporting.

• End-to-End Project Management: You manage system integrations from scoping to post-production, delivering data-driven projects in fast-paced environments.

• LEAN Mindset: You apply LEAN principles to optimise processes and eliminate inefficiencies in integrated financial systems.

• Finance Knowledge: You have a solid understanding of finance and accounting, enabling effective collaboration with Finance teams.

• You create energy and clarity. You have great communication skills that help you bring people together behind a common goal, manage multiple points of view and create clarity and organisation into complex problems and diverse teams.

Additional Information

• Base salary: £90-115K (based on experience & interview outcomes)

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) & a variety of other benefits: Wise Benefits

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

Through our coaching and training programmes, you'll develop the skill sets you need, all while building a network of colleagues, mentors and leaders who will accompany you on your journey at EY and beyond.

The opportunity

In our assurance team, you won't be endlessly crunching numbers. Instead, you'll be a part of teams, working with clients to understand their businesses and financial accounts. You'll identify, assess, and address risks and do much more. Our cutting-edge technology automates routine tasks, so you'll have more freedom to focus on clients.

• Seeking out opportunities to build, expand and share knowledge

Skills And Attributes For Success

In 2016, to drive social mobility across professional services we removed the requirement to have minimum UCAS points or degree classification to make an application. Whilst some academic qualification will still be considered, it’s no longer a barrier to start your career with us.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

This role will work in a project team bringing advanced quantitative and data driven techniques to highly complex disputes involving financial markets and securities litigation.

## Key accountabilities

The Financial Economist will work on financial projects that require econometric, statistical or other more quantitative/qualitative financial analysis techniques. Some notable responsibilities will include:

- Conducting detailed qualitative and quantitative financial analysis of allegations of financial misconduct as part of the delivery of Fideres’ expert consulting mandates
- Data extraction, cleaning, processing, manipulation and management for data heavy projects
- Writing comprehensive reports that summarize the key findings of our analysis in a simple, succinct manner
- Verbally presenting key findings to clients in a manner that allows them to understand both the results and how they impact their own clients
- Communicating with clients and stakeholders in a timely, clear and concise manner
- Taking the initiative in suggesting ways to strengthen the quality of our analysis; with progression to proactively developing new business opportunities

## Key skills and attributes

- A keen interest in financial markets and a strong belief in fair and transparent markets
- A strong record of academic achievement with a relevant degree(s) in economics, financial economics, statistics or other quantitative subjects (data analysis, mathematics etc.)
- Proficiency with data analysis software and programming experience (e.g., Python, R, Excel)
- Some hands-on experience in complex/big data manipulation, management, and analysis. Experience of database programs (e.g., SQL, Postgres) is a plus
- Solid understanding of data analysis techniques, and statistical inference
- Attention to detail and a commitment to going the extra mile to produce rigorous, accurate work, within the constraints of the time and resources available
- Excellent written and verbal communication, including experience of writing reports and presentations
- Strong communication skills and enjoys building relationships with key stakeholders, has the ability to explain economic concepts and quantitative results, as well as their implications, to non-specialists
- Integrity, and a creative, curious mind
- A high level of accountability, and not afraid to express and opinion and offer new solutions

Fideres’s vision is to become the leader in litigation-only economic consulting globally, free of corporate conflicts.

Following years of growth, over the past two years Fideres has started to expand internationally and we now have offices established in London, New York, Rome and Madrid. We plan to open an office in Australia and to grow our presence in France and Germany.

We are looking for candidates, who are committed to Fideres’s strategy and values, and who are willing to grow in this phase of our company’s expansion.

You will get to work in a highly innovative environment where training and development is put at the top of the agenda to ensure that our staff are at the leading edge of their academic knowledge, and where rapid career progression is available to proactive employees who reach out for opportunities.

We offer competitive salaries and bonuses, and competitive benefits.

We are proud of our values and our diverse and international workforce, and we are committed to building a working environment where employees feel safe, welcome and able to have an open and respectful dialogue on diversity issues.

## Transparent pay

We have a transparent and internally published pay structure by role, we do this as part of an equal pay initiative across our offices.

## Continuous learning

We offer all our employees a learning and development budget to spend flexibly on role relevant training needs. There is no risk of being pigeon-holed at Fideres as our employees are able to reach for opportunities as they see them without being restricted by corporate bureaucracy.

We offer all normal standard benefits such as a competitive holiday allowance with the opportunity to purchase 10 days additional holiday, monthly social events, private medical insurance, a gym subsidy, equal family leave for all employees, along with other benefits.

Depending on the role you are applying for, you may be asked to complete a pre-interview assessment relevant to the role. This allows us to see if you have some of the necessary technical skills required for the role, and it can also give you an idea of some of the skills that would be required.

For the majority of our roles, we have a three stage interview process. The main purpose of our interviews is to further assess your technical skills, your communication skills (team and client) and make sure that you have sufficiently researched what we do and the role itself.
